name: Amane Nozomu
source:
A nurse who works at the same hospital as Kimika. She has a quiet, somewhat mysterious air about her and is known throughout the hospital as a cool lady who seems to appear and disappear out of nowhere.

She’s an excellent worker, and her skills are highly regarded, but… whenever she opens her mouth, she seems a bit off, as if she holds values that differ slightly from common sense.

[From [url=https://syrup-soft.com/hs/chuforyou/chara.html#nozomu]official site[/url]]
